In the third O site, O is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na and one N atom. In the fourth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to one Na, one Co, and one N atom. In the tenth O site, O is bonded in a 3-coordinate geometry to two Na and one N atom. In the eleventh O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Co, and one N atom. In the twelfth O site, O is bonded in a distorted T-shaped geometry to one Na, one Co, and one N atom.
